pages.text: A RESULT line is an output of a function.

Below a FUNCTION, it has a name and a type. It starts with the default value of its type. When the function ends, its last value goes back to the caller. Below a CALL, it names a result and the variable that receives it.$(br2)RESULT lines come after the PARAMETER lines. Results the caller doesn't list are thrown away.
Turn one PARAMETER block into a RESULT block.
$(1)CALL c0de/math/ROUND$(br)  PARAMETER value 12.5 ;$(br)  RESULT result rounded$()
The result $(1)result$() of ROUND goes into the variable $(1)rounded$().
